item.text: I’ll write `{"output":{"word":"done"}}` to the specified result file without changing repository files.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('{{result}}')
path.write_text(json.dumps({'output': {'word': 'done'}}) + '\\n')
assert json.loads(path.read_text()) == {'output': {'word': 'done'}}
PY"
